(A FRESH install.sh deploys them; the gap is the update path only.) Pause-to-fix invoked; shakedown is PAUSED awaiting this fix on main.

CHIRON + HAMILTON (Arc 61/62 MAJORs) were never added -> invisible to MISSING detection. This is the root cause of the observed symptom.

 - check.sh apply_substitutions() :119 (NAME_SUFFIX case pattern) — needed for subproject-tier byte-compare.
 - install.sh write_substrate_manifest() :540-544 (manifest emission) — A2A's originally-cited locus; needed for deploy-time manifest completeness, but NOT the cause of the MISSING-detection symptom.

Verify CHIRON/HAMILTON's ACTUAL deploy suffix rules in install.sh DEST_* (955-963) per tier before encoding enumerate_deployed (MAJOR suffix rules differ project vs subproject).

The existing FAIL-LOUD subproject recompose stays green (probe V3). App green (gen-data/build/test). NOMOS CONFORMANT. SCOPE: only the MAJOR-enumeration completeness fix across check.sh + install.sh manifest; do NOT touch role files or expand check.sh refactors.
